issues.current: Four colleagues took on their own record attempts, and of course we filmed everything. None of the official world records were broken, but we got five videos and a little more respect for people who do this professionally. See for yourself how it went.

issues.reason: “Took on their own record attempts” is unidiomatic.

issues.current: The first tower collapses. Martin laughs and builds on.
